## Change and scientific scope

Describe the problem, affected record IDs, biological material and resulting
agent behavior. Link sources and exact sections/tables. Identify uncertainty.

## Checks

- [ ] Existing entries searched; IDs reused appropriately; unrelated work preserved.
- [ ] Claims use the narrowest justified taxon, specimen, assembly and annotation scope.
- [ ] Sources verified to the stated extent; reuse terms respected.
- [ ] Index, registries and supersession references updated when needed.
- [ ] Evidence type kept separate from human review; AI additions remain draft.
- [ ] Relevant reasoning case and positive control added or explained as unnecessary.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` and `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` pass.
- [ ] Warnings, access failures and AI assistance disclosed below.
